_readme: OPTIONAL. Photos work perfectly well without this file — delete these two
lines and it still loads. Use it when you want a specific caption or a
better description for screen readers on a particular photo.
The key is the folder and filename exactly as it appears in this folder.
alt     = describes the photo for someone who cannot see it
caption = the words printed under the photo
title   = the heading above a before/after pair (set it on either half)
Example — delete the _example block below once you have real entries:

_example/before-01.jpg.alt: An overgrown back garden with waist-high grass and brambles along the fence
_example/before-01.jpg.caption: Rishton — garden clearance, two years of growth
_example/before-01.jpg.title: Full garden clearance in Rishton
